ambiguities: Rows are built only for team slots of kept games (season >= 2014 with home_score present, per section 1 'Games'); unplayed scheduled games produce no rows.
'Played games' of a team = kept games (season >= 2010, home_score present), ordered by (date, game_id); 'last k games dated before d' uses strictly earlier dates.
Window sum S_i taken with 1-indexed attempt counter: S_i = W_i - r^700 * W_{i-700} for i > 700, i.e. sum over the last 700 attempts; W computed by recursion W_i = r*W_{i-1} + x_i.
The passer's S state, passer-game state game, and tdl_persistent use all his attempts regardless of posteam (not only those for pteam).
Candidate for both teams: q compared per team (latest prev-game date with an attempt for that team); tie broken by alphabetically smaller team code (after OAK/SD/STL replacement).
Club rate t and opponent defence aggregates sum over the listed games; games where the team had no attempts contribute nothing. Opponent attempts with missing defteam are never matched.
qcc_rho_pre own-game n and c = the passer's attempts and completions in the row's game over all his attempts in that game (any posteam). If REF is empty, rho is missing (did not occur).
qcc_rho_pre REF includes all rows of seasons max(2013,S-3)..S-1 meeting the n>=10 and qcc_p_pre-present conditions; each REF row contributes one term with equal weight.
lg_int for a row of season S is the mean int over all attempts of season S-1 (all passers, all teams).
Season 2013 rows were computed (for rho only) with the same candidate/dedupe rules and are not output.
xTD cell: yardline_100 missing -> yb 4 (as stated); air_yards missing -> ab 0. p_cell computed from REF attempts with td = (pass_touchdown == 1).
